## Task

What needs to be done, and which part of the research plan does it support?

## Output and acceptance

State the file, code, measurement, or decision this task should produce. Give checks that can show whether it is done. A documented negative result or convergence failure may be an acceptable output.

## Inputs and dependencies

Link the protocol, source note, issue, or code this task needs. State any unresolved choice rather than guessing it.

## Compute and evidence

For a run, state the machine, approved budget, accuracy check, measurement boundary, and recording plan. Mark this section not applicable for tasks that do not run experiments.

## Ownership

Claim the task before starting. Note the files you expect to change and any shared work that needs coordination. Do not assign someone without agreement.

## Completion checks

- [ ] The output meets the stated acceptance checks.
- [ ] Results and claims link to evidence; failures and limits are recorded.
- [ ] The writing follows the shared guide and keeps protected values unchanged.
- [ ] Relevant tests ran, with failures or skipped checks stated.
